comment: The knobs are configured -4.f to 6.f, which is wider than the ±5V spelling the range field allows; the output's real span is -4V to 6V. The whole grid is rewritten from ALL_SCALES_AND_ARPS whenever the root note, scale, direction, transpose or octave count changes, so hand-set knobs do not survive a menu change. A reset trigger calls onReset(), which is the module's initialise path and also forces the probability parameter back to 1. The root-note CV is matched against exact integer hundredths of a volt with no tolerance, so only the precise voltages a quantised C4-to-B4 source gives will select anything but B.
